title: No-Contact Conditions of Pretrial Release
citation: Criminal Justice Reform Act, N.J.S.A. 2A:162-15 et seq.; N.J.S.A. 2C:29-9
key_points: When releasing a defendant, a judge can order no contact with the victim or witnesses as a condition of release.
In DV cases, violating these conditions can be charged as contempt under 2C:29-9(b).
The prosecutor can also move to revoke release when conditions are violated.
Check release conditions in the court system when a victim reports contact.
